description: Concrete model names for the cheap/standard/strong spawn tiers defined in spawn-model-routing.md. Operator-maintained: update model names here as new models roll out; do not change the tier abstraction. Runtime config, not enforced by Autopraxis code.

tier_roles.cheap: simple, high-volume, objectively verifiable spawn work (context extraction, docs/link/package validation, deterministic-check interpretation)
tier_roles.standard: sub-agent work: first-pass PR review, routine implementation, routine debugging, generalist council personas
tier_roles.strong: orchestration and high-stakes work: parent/orchestrator, council synthesis, ML/statistical/security/reliability blocker decisions

anthropic.notes: Orchestration/synthesis on opus (or a higher 'fable'-class tier when available). Pin exact dated model ids in runtime config.

openai.notes: sol = orchestration, terra = sub-agent work, luna = simple/high-volume. Pin exact dated model ids in runtime config.

moonshot.notes: Kimi: K3 = orchestration, K2.6 = sub-agent work, K2.5 = simple/high-volume. Pin exact dated model ids in runtime config.

maintenance.how_to_update: When a provider ships a new model, update the tier value(s) for that provider, bump policy_version and last_checked. Keep the cheap/standard/strong keys stable so skills and telemetry stay valid.
maintenance.verification: Model names are operator-supplied and must be verified against current provider docs before relying on them for cost/routing decisions.
